patch_description:
Resetting Adam’s accumulated moments when the soft-contact objective becomes substantially sharper prevents momentum fitted to broad pair distributions from destabilizing newly active closest and farthest contacts. The replacement also uses a more conservative learning-rate multiplier and longer second-moment memory at high beta values.

A short final backtracking phase then operates directly on the best exact candidate. It alternates sharp soft-contact sets and accepts only changes that improve the evaluator’s actual squared-distance ratio, so it cannot degrade the best candidate obtained by the population search.
